web_events.query: US economic data release this week CPI GDP jobs
web_events.answer: This week's US economic data releases include the July Consumer Price Index (CPI) on August 17, which is expected to show a year-over-year inflation rate of 3.5%, down from 3.7% in the previous month. The Producer Price Index (PPI) for July is also due on August 13, providing insights into price pressures further up the supply chain. Additionally, the second estimate of Q2 GDP and corporate profits will be released on August 26, with expectations of a slowdown in growth to 1.5% annualized pace.
